metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace hosted in the Codex-plugin-Claude-Code repo.

plugins.name: codex-plugin
plugins.description: Claude Code orchestrates; OpenAI Codex implements. Claude owns requirements, design direction, acceptance criteria and delivery judgment; Codex does code investigation, implementation design, coding, tests and reporting. Work is split into tasks and committed one at a time, gated on a per-task file allowlist and a green test run.
